title: The USA's oil race, 2010 to 2024
description:
In 2010 the USA was third in oil. By 2024 it made 2.6 times as much.
From 3,875 TWh in 2010 to 9,977 TWh in 2024, 63% more than Russia.
Move supply and demand yourself: https://rimilab.com/#/mba/supply-demand
Data: Energy Institute, via Our World in Data (CC BY 4.0).
